senses.en_definition: A spoken reply to a call or question.
To answer a question, respond to a call, or reply to a letter or message.

collocations.en: answer a phone call; respond to a call

messages.en: Did you see my message earlier about dinner? You haven't replied yet.
I was driving earlier. I've parked now, so I've finally got a chance to reply. Does eight work for you?
Sure. See you at our usual place, yeah?

senses.en_definition: An answer or reply to a question or remark.
A written answer or solution to a question or problem, especially in an examination.

collocations.en: an answer key and marking scheme

messages.en: Have you worked out the answer to question five yet? I've done it twice, but I got different answers.
I got twelve. Did you work out what was in the brackets first?
Oh, I missed that step. Hang on, let me try again.

senses.en_definition: Only; just; a colloquial form of sahaja, placed after the word or phrase it limits.
A colloquial particle used to soften a suggestion, offer reassurance, or present something as easy or unproblematic.
The name of the letter J or j in the Roman alphabet.

messages.en: I'm going to get some drinks. Do you want iced tea or iced coffee?
Just plain water for me. Don't bother getting anything sweet. I just had some tea.
Hey, there are footprints on the floor I just mopped!
Oops, I just came in from outside. I'll wipe them up in a bit, okay?
